title: Finite-cover Cech fibres have the same component labels after base change
statement: Let $p:Z\to S$ be finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], let $h:U\to S$ be any scheme morphism, and let $b_U$ be a geometric point of $U$ with image $b$ in $S$ [def-weil-geometric-point]. Put $Z_U=U\times_SZ$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Projection induces a bijection $\pi_0((Z_U)_{b_U})\xrightarrow{\sim}\pi_0(Z_b)$ between the sets of connected components of the two geometric fibres. In particular this applies to every finite iterated fibre product $Z^{(q)}=Z^{\times_S(q+1)}$, $q\ge0$.

source.place: Lemma 2.6.1, printed p. 5: the canonical component bijection; no additional Cech or arbitrary-map compatibility is asserted.
